messages:
aisha: Heads-up — planning to onboard vendetta-2b into the model catalog tomorrow. Need a deploy window, smoke owner, and rollback plan. TL;DR: small canary -> 1h quiet window -> promote. @trent can you run the deploy? @liz want you on smoke checks. Details below.

trent: I can take the deploy. Window 11:00-12:00 UTC works for me. Who's owning canary config and monitoring?

kevin: I'll provide the runtime config. Recommend 5% canary (1 instance), use quantized v2 artifact we tested. Perf baseline from staging: median latency ~38ms @128 tokens. Suggested canary config: ```json
{"canary_pct":5,"instances":1,"max_concurrency":24,"probe_path":"/healthz"}
```

liz: I'll own smoke checks. I'll run the smoke prompt set, basic safety checks, latency/throughput sanity, and verify fallback. My checklist: 1) health endpoint green 2) run 50 shared prompts 3) check sample hallucination cases 4) confirm metrics in datadog dashboard. Will post results here.

maya: Catalog note: artifacts already ingested under vendetta-2b@2026-03-20-rc1. After canary success I'll pin alias vendetta-2b -> vendetta-2b@2026-03-20-rc1. No schema changes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved for vendetta-2b: 2026-03-20T11:00Z -> 2026-03-20T12:00Z. Canary policy attached.

trent: Starting canary now (11:05 UTC). Command used: ```bash
redwood deploy start --model vendetta-2b --variant rc1 --canary 5%
```
Logs snapshot: ```INFO canary started on node gpu-42; model vendetta-2b@2026-03-20-rc1```

liz: Smoke run at 11:10: health endpoints OK, ran 50 prompts: 48 passed, 2 flagged for slight brevity on summary prompt. Latency median 42ms, p95 120ms. Posting one flagged example: ```input: 'Summarize the following 600-word article'
expected: concise multi-sentence summary
actual: single sentence that misses point about policy section
```

kevin: Noted. That one regression looks prompt-specific. If it reproduces under higher traffic we can fallback to quantized variant vendetta-2b@quant1 instantly. Rollback command: ```bash
redwood deploy rollback --model vendetta-2b --to vendetta-2b@quant1 --reason "regression flag"
```

aisha: Thanks all. Plan: if no new blockers, promote to stable at ~11:45 UTC and then pin alias. @liz please confirm final smoke by 11:40 so @maya can pin. @trent will you monitor rollbacks?

trent: Affirmative. I'll watch metrics and be ready to run the rollback command.

liz: Final smoke pass at 11:38 — all green except the small note already reported (low severity). Recommend proceed.

maya: Pinning alias now. Done at 11:46Z: alias vendetta-2b -> vendetta-2b@2026-03-20-rc1.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary complete. Promoted to 100% at 11:47Z.

aisha: Closing thread — great work team :tada: If any follow-ups (metrics drift, user reports) open new thread and ping infra/ops.
